shortDescription: Polymarket’s "NRFI" yes option in the Los Angeles Dodgers vs. Detroit Tigers market fell sharply from 42.5% one hour ago to 22.5% at present, a 20-point swing. According to ChainCatcher, the move was tracked by Catcher Predict and may reflect the impact of related breaking news.
